structure_explanation.en: Here the target pattern 〜といいです appears again to express a wish. The subject 新しい仕事 ('a new job') is marked by が and followed by the intransitive verb 見つかる ('to be found, to turn up'); then と + いいです form 'I hope it turns up.'
